summary: This RFC reproduces a draft of the ISO transport protocol that was being standardized at the time, previously printed in a 1982 journal. It was published for information, and the RFC itself says that version is out of date. It was replaced by RFC 905.

eli5.summary: This is a copy of an early draft of another group's rulebook for delivering data. The draft got old, so a newer copy replaced it.

questions: what is the iso transport protocol
